3. Connector
3.1 Read Connector Details
 Basic Information
Path: /v1/interface/list-detail
Method: GET
Description:
1. When splitId != 0, this interfaceId signifies the unique ID of the split source of the main
source.
2. Optional parameters for the query: if no parameters are provided, all data is returned. If
multiple parameters are provided, they must satisfy an & condition.
